props.title:
==GitCheck==
Know your license chain before it knows you.
props.subtitle: Paste a repo URL. Get the full dependency license map — and every conflict — in seconds.

slides.notes: Open with the hook: most teams ship licenses they've never read. GitCheck reads them all, automatically.

props.title: Every dependency ==drags in a license== — and some conflict.
props.body: Copyleft meets proprietary, MIT meets GPL, terms collide upstream-vs-upstream. Teams find out late: at review, at acquisition, or after launch.

slides.notes: A single transitive dependency can change your obligations. Nobody reads the whole tree by hand — that's the gap.

props.title: One URL in. ==The whole chain, mapped.==
